book.name: MATEO
book.title: Mateo' pilla Diosa' mika ura kuinda

content: Juan Mungaamu peñu kuinda
Tsangues nenu tinbutala Galileasha chumu uñi Herodes, chachilla Jesúsnu laapu' patu naa naadetiñu bain kuinda meemeekemi.
Tsejtu ya' chachillanu tsandimi: Chachilla patindetsushu juntsa rukuya Juan Mungaamu peyaishu juntsave, mangujpatu. Tsa' mityaa naa tiba tsamantsaa ke' keewara juula bain kenuu juve, timi.
Entsa Herodesya Juannu peesu kakare' jeru chuwachi teleke' peesu pumuwaami, ya' naatala Filipo' shinbu Herodías' mityaren,
matyu Juan, Herodesnu entsa entsandimuwaañu: Juntsanu ñu' shinbu juu tanañu urajtuve, tiitimuwaami.
Tsenñu Herodes Juannu tu'nu tyaturen chachillanu jeetyami, matyu mu bain Juanya Diosa' mitya pamu rukuve tya tyadeiñu' mitya.
Tsenñuren Herodes' nakayanu malu manchañu fandangu kendetsuñu, Herodías' na'ma junu wa'namula' ajuusha beelanguemi. Tsejtu Herodeschi yuj sundyanu' keñu, sundenganchiren
juntsa na'manu ti pa'ñuba Diosnu paka' tsanguenbera kenu tsuyu ti' ma tsandimuwaami.
Tsenñu juntsa na'ma ya' ama Herodías paviñu, Herodesnu tsandimuwaami: Juan Mungaamu' mishpukaa palatunu puu taja' inu enu kuwaka, timuwaami.

Tsenñu rei Herodes mika llakindyami, tsejturen tsanguenbera kenu tsuyu ti', tsanguityushu juntsaa yanu Dios taaju puitesa ti' ma pati' mityaa, tsenmin junu pumu chachilla' ajuusharen ma tsandi' mitya, naati pa'ñuba tsanguikaamuwaami.
Tsejtu peesusha Juan' mishpuka daakakaanu uudenguemuwaami.
Tsangue' juntsa mishpuka palatunu puuya detaja', juntsa na'manu kuwañu, ya' amanu kuwami.
Tsenñu Juan' disipulula deji', ya' ujkun bulu ka' demenjitu, bene Jesúsnu wainjila.
5.000 pullaa chachillanuJesús panda fikaami.
Tsaa kuinda mijatu, Jesús baakunu vi' junu lu' jiimi, muba den netyuinsha maali punu. Tsenñun chachilla demijatu, yai bain yala' pebulutala delu' ji' tutu surekila.
Tsenñu Jesús ya' jinu baakusha pu' tusha lutu, chachilla tsamantsadena katatu yuj tenbityami. Tsejtu juntsa kejtsapala dilu pumulanuya ura' demandirekemi.

Tsenñu yumaa dekependu' kantsuñu, ya' disipulula Jesús' keesha jitu tsandila: Yumaa ma dekependu' kakentsuve; entsa tenashaa muba den nei'nu tenave. Tsa' mitya chachillanu deme-eenu kide, kaa pebulutalaaba deji' tyeeba ati'ka' finudetsu, tila.
Tsa detiñun Jesús entsandimi: Ti' mityaba yala miinu dejutyuve; ñullaa yalanu panda kuwadei, timi.
Tsenñu yala pakatu: ¡Enuya lala pan, ka manda ta', allaya pallu tadenayu! tila.
Tsenñu Jesús tsandimi: Tsaaya, engu inu taja' kuwakai, timi.

Tsejtu chachillanu ishtapetala dechungaakaatu, bene ya' tyaapachi man pan bain, pai alla bain kaketu, kai'sha ke'laadi', Diosnu yuj urave titu, pan dedaaka', ya' disipululanu kuwañu, yalaa junu pumu chachillanu veela.
Tsenñu kumuinchi chachilla panda tyubanbera defiñu laramu mande'kakitun, 12 kubi jungue mande'kala.
Panda fimula unbee rukulan juuren 5.000 chachi ma fikeñunguila, naa supulanu bain, naa kaillanu bain mikajturen.
Jesús pi jandala nemi.
Tsanguemin Jesús ya' disipulula bejkusha ajke' demandyakasa tyatu, baakusha jeke deme-eepu' me-eemi. Tsaindetsuren yaa junu wa'namu chachillanu deme-eren pumi.
Jesús tsangue' chachillanu deme-eetu, kuyisha lumi maalindala Diosba kuinda kenu. Tsejtu ya junga maali puren kepemi.
Tsejtu yaa tsananmala, ya' disipulula' miinu baakuya yumaa aa pusu pi kejtala lui miintsumi, tsejtu ishuwa yalanu masmi' juyikentsuñu' mitya pisundachi banvillasai miintsula.
Dechanusha kayu dedanguenu jutyunu uwanu Jesús pi jandalaren yala' junga miintsumi.
Tsenñu ya' disipulula pinu ma neintsu dekata-eetu, wapana' dejeetya' ui'tu, ¡Ujmu jee! tiitila.
Tsa detiñu Jesús jeti entsandimi: Puluke pensanguidei; iyaa tsaintsuyu. Jeetyatyudei, timi.
Tsenñu Pedro pakatu: Bale Ruku, uwain ñutuya, inuba ñu' junga pi jandala mikaka, timi.
Tsenñu Jesús: Tsaaya jade, timi. Tsandiñu Pedro baakunu pajtya' pi jandala Jesús' junga jintsumi.
Tsaaren ishuwa daran juyintsuñuba mijaimiren jeetyaimi, tsenmin tsaa chukanu kikentsumin entsandi wapan pami: ¡Bale Ruku, inu la'kaka! timi.
Tsandinmalan Jesús, Pedro' tyaapanu jeke kami, tsejtu tsandimi: ¡Ura' keranguityu unbere! ¿Nenñaa uwain tsaañanga tyatu iyu? timi.
Tsejtu yala baakusha demavinmalaren ishuwa mandyaimi.
Tsenñu baakusha pumula Jesús' ajuusha teledenaji', aawa kure' keewaatu tsandila: Uwain ñuya Diosa' Nave, tila.
Genesaretsha dilu chumulanuJesús ura' mandiremi.
Tsejtu juntsa aa pusunu detyaka' Genesaret tusha jila.
Tsenñu junu chumu chachilla naa Jesúsñuba dekeengala, tsejtu nuka tenasha bain juntsa kuinda demijatu, naaju dilulanu bain Jesús' junga taji tajiila.
Tsejtu jayuya ka naa jai kapanuuñuba ta'kakutide ti' u'ta u'tandila. Tsanditu naajula bain ta'kamulaya ura' mandiya mandiyaila.
